gaps.title: Archer's Death Lockdown Partner

gaps.benchmark: Death Pressure Economy < 9.50, high dot %, yorker reliability

journey_thread.text: 🧵 1/8 Back in June 2026, I built QUWROF: an advanced IPL rating engine designed to evaluate players across phases, leverage, and context. Today, I'm releasing the Rajasthan Royals 2027 Mega Auction Blueprint for #SupeRRSelector. Here is how we did it:

2/8 In QUWROF v1-v14, we discovered a fatal flaw in naive pressure rating: ratio metrics (Pres/Base) favor mediocre players with low baselines over genuine superstars. A 120 SR batter jumping from 100 gets 1.20x; Heinrich Klaasen at 180 SR from 175 gets 1.03x. That's absurd.

3/8 We engineered the Dual-Criterion Model: 50% Normalized Absolute Output (benchmarked vs P85/P15 elite performers) + 50% Relative Maintenance + 65:35 IPL:T20I Bayesian Shrinkage. Tested across 200,999 deliveries, it eliminates baseline bias.

4/8 Then we audited RR's 2026 season (16 matches, 9 wins, 7 losses) ball-by-ball. While Vaibhav Sooryavanshi had a 100th percentile season (776 runs @ 237 SR) and Jofra Archer took 25 wickets, RR had 3 critical structural flaws in their 7 defeats:

5/8 Deficit 1: In losses, RR conceded 12.30 RPO in overs 16-20 (vs 9.24 in wins). Sandeep Sharma (13.3 ER) and Deshpande (11.25 ER) collapsed. When Archer finished his quota, opponents dismantled the death overs uncontested.
6/8 Deficit 2: Powerplay Toothlessness. In 9 wins, RR took 24 PP wickets. In 7 losses, RR took just 4 wickets total in 42 PP overs (0.57/game) while conceding 11.50 RPO. Opposition openers ran wild.
7/8 Deficit 3: Finisher Fragility. Shimron Hetmyer collapsed in 2026 (78 runs, 113 SR, 22nd percentile). In chases, RR middle-overs SR slumped to 142.6. When Donovan Ferreira fell, the innings died.

8/8 Our 2027 Mega Auction Solution:
🎯 Gap 1: Jamie Overton (6.62 death pres econ) & Sakib Hussain (7.70 ER)
🎯 Gap 2: Mohammed Siraj (45 PP wkts) / Khaleel Ahmed (7.79 ER)
🎯 Gap 3: Naman Dhir (209.5 death pres SR) & Cooper Connolly (212.8 SR)
Full dashboard live!
